scope: The A431 cells (DSMZ #ACC-91, tested for, and found free of, Mycoplasma contamination) and normal tissues were lysed in SDS-lysis buffer (4% (w/v) SDS, 25 mM HEPES pH 7.6, 1 mM DTT).

Lysates were then heated at 95 °C for 5 min in a thermomixer, and were sonicated with a probe sonicator (Bandelin Sonopuls, Buch and Holm) twice using 50% duty cycle, 50% power for 15 s, in order to shear DNA.

Samples were centrifuged at 14,000 × g to remove cell debris, the supernatant was collected and protein concentration estimated by the DC-protein assay (BioRad) following the manufacturer’s instructions.
